content: SendGrid Event Webhook uses ECDSA signatures via X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature and X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Timestamp headers, computed over SHA-256(timestamp + raw body). Critical: verify against the RAW request body/Buffer before any JSON body-parser touches it (exclude the webhook route from express.json()/fastify's default body parser, or capture rawBody). Reject events with timestamps older than ~5 minutes (replay protection), respond 200 within 10s (SendGrid retries otherwise), process asynchronously via queue, and dedupe using sg_event_id for idempotency.
